name: List interconnect Details
description: List interconnect Details Lists details for a specific interconnect. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf_interconnects/{cf_interconnect_id}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf_interconnects/{cf_interconnect_id}
Lists details for a specific interconnect.
Required: cf_interconnect_id (path); account_id (path)
Optional: x-magic-new-hc-target (header) — If true, the health check target in the response body will be presented using the new object format. Defaults to false.

name: Update interconnect
description: Update interconnect Updates a specific interconnect associated with an account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf_interconnects/{cf_interconnect_id}
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf_interconnects/{cf_interconnect_id}
Updates a specific interconnect associated with an account. Use `?validate_only=true` as an optional query parameter to only run validation without persisting changes.
Required: cf_interconnect_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)
Optional: x-magic-new-hc-target (header) — If true, the health check target in the request and response bodies will be presented using the new object format. Defaults to false.
